name: outcome-monorepo
description: Pay agents for verified results, not attempts.

scripts.build: npm run build -w outcome-policy && npm run build -w outcome-bureau && npm run build -w outcome-escalation && npm run build -w outcome-sdk && npm run build -w outcome-mcp
scripts.test: npm run test -w outcome-policy && npm run test -w outcome-bureau && npm run test -w outcome-escalation && npm run test -w outcome-sdk && npm run test -w outcome-mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w outcome-policy && npm run typecheck -w outcome-bureau && npm run typecheck -w outcome-escalation && npm run typecheck -w outcome-sdk && npm run typecheck -w outcome-mcp && npm run typecheck -w outcome-gateway
